title: Weinbrenner deathbed claim of ET bodies in Utah

tellings.quote: there's a lot of research proposed by like Grant Cameron and um Anthony Brigalia and so forth about uh wine Brener on his deathbed saying that they house uh dead extraterrestrials at a facility out in Utah which of course is Dougway proving grounds.

plain: A man named Weinbrenner is said to have claimed on his deathbed that dead beings from another world are kept at a facility in Utah, which is taken to be Dugway Proving Ground, a military testing range there. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb passes this on, crediting the work of the UFO researchers Grant Cameron and Anthony Bragalia rather than any account of his own. If true, it would place alien bodies in US government hands at a known base.
